CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MARCH 11, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Mary Zendejas, 1st District  Megan Kerr, 5th District
Cindy Allen, 2nd District  Dr. Suely Saro, 6th District
Kristina Duggan, 3rd District  Roberto Uranga, Vice Mayor, 7th District
Daryl Supernaw, 4th District  Tunua Thrash-Ntuk, 8th District
  Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, 9th District
Thomas B. Modica, City Manager
Monique De La Garza, City Clerk  Rex Richardson, Mayor  Dawn McIntosh, City Attorney

  REVISED

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS AND
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC
 The consent calendar shall be heard immediately after the pledge of allegiance, and prior to 6:30 PM.
  All matters listed under the Consent Calendar are to be considered routine by the City Council and
 will all be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of said items unless the
 Mayor, City Councilmembers or the City Manager request specific items be discussed and/or
 removed from the Consent Calendar for separate action.

 CONSENT CALENDAR (1 – 15)

 1.  25-54545  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $6,000, offset by the Fifth Council District One-Time
  Priority Funds transferred from the Citywide Activities Department to provide a
  contribution to the following organizations:
  • $2,500 to the Bixby Knolls Business Improvement Association in support of
  the renovation and creation of a community board room;
  • $750 to the Long Beach Nonprofit Partnership in support of their Long
  Beach Gives event;
  • $750 to Conservation Corps of Long Beach in support of their Dine on Pine
  event;
  • $500 to the United Cambodian Community in support of the Sankranta
  event;
  • $500 to Lakewood Village Little League in support of their ongoing
  programming and support their ongoing mission;
  • $500 to Uptown Long Beach Youth Baseball in support of their ongoing
  programming and support their ongoing mission;

  Page 1 of 10
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MARCH 11, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  • $500 to Friends of the Long Beach Firefighters; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $6,000, to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Megan Kerr, Councilwoman, Fifth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-54592  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $4,000, offset by the Seventh Council District One-Time
  District Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to
  provide support for the following:
  1. $500 to Black Employees Association of Long Beach in support of a Black
  History Month Celebration at City Hall;
  2. $1,000 to WomenShelter of Long Beach in support of their annual Gala;
  3. $1,000 to the Conservation Corps of Long Beach for their 2025 Dine on
  Pine event;
  4. $1,000 to United Cambodian Community to support their Cambodia Town
  Food Fest;
  5. $500 to Long Beach Community College Foundation in support of their
  adaptive sports event; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $4,000, to offset transfers to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Roberto Uranga, Vice Mayor, Seventh District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-54598  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $1,700, offset by Fourth Council District One-time District
  Priority Funds transferred from the Citywide Activities Department to provide
  support to LBC Hero Squad for the Buffum Total Learning Center’s Community
  Resource Fair; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $1,700, to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Daryl Supernaw, Councilman, Fourth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-54589  Recommendation to adopt resolution supporting the South Coast Air Quality
  Management (SCAQMD) Proposed Amended Rules 1111 and 1121 related to the

  equipment used as household items. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Attorney

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  between February 24, 2025 and March 3, 2025.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  documents necessary for the Second Amendment to Right-of-Entry Permit No. P-
  00440 with KB Home Coastal Inc., for the continued use of a City-owned property
  located at 5901 Atlantic Avenue as a staging area in connection with the nearby
  residential development project for one year, with a one-year renewal option at the
  discretion of the City Manager. (District 9)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Economic Development

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  agreement, and any necessary documents or subsequent amendments, including
  any amendment to increase the initial grant term or initial award amount, with the
  South Bay Workforce Investment Board (SBWIB), processed through the City of
  Inglewood funded by the U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) Apprenticeship Building
  America (ABA) grant under AP-38900-22-60-A-6, to accept and expend grant
  funding in an initial amount of $25,000 to expand non-traditional registered
  apprenticeship(s) in California upon execution of the contract to March 31, 2026.
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Economic Development

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-54513  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary for a Second Amendment to Lease No. 35645 with GCC
  Long Beach, LLC. (Landlord), for the City of Long Beach’s continued use of 2019
  East Wardlow Road as a temporary Fire Station 9 for 12 additional months through

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Economic Development; Fire Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Changes in the City of Long Beach, November 2023 through November 2024.”
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Energy Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 25-54503  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to implement a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with
  Kaiser Foundation Health Plan, Inc. and Health Net Community Solutions, Inc. for
  a period of three years, with the option to renew for three additional one-year
  periods, at the discretion of the City Manager, unless written notice of non-renewal
  is given with 180 days by either party. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 25-54504  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to implement a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with
  Local Initiative Health Authority of Los Angeles County operating as and doing
  business as L.A. Care Health Plan; Blue Cross of California doing business as
  Anthem Blue Cross, a California health care service plan; and Blue Shield of
  California Promise Health Plan, a California health care service plan, to enhance
  the referral and enrollment of WIC eligible families of the Health Care Plans and
  receive the WIC services provided, effective as of the Execution Date, for a period
  of three years with the option to extend for three additional one-year periods, at the
  discretion of the City Manager, unless written notice of non-renewal is given with
  30 days by any party. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 25-54506  Recommendation to adopt resolution approving a Letter of Agreement to the 2022-
  2025 Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Police Officers Association

  Investigator – NC classification and to modify two existing Police Investigator – NC
  classification pay rates. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Human Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

13. 25-54508  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to approve a fee waiver
  for the Western Flyer Foundation, in an amount not to exceed $400, for use of 80
  linear feet of dock space in Alamitos Bay Marina for mooring on March 21 through
  23, 2025. (District 3)

  Office or Department:  Parks, Recreation and Marine

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

14. 25-54507  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to amend Contract No. 35545 with Great Scott Tree Service,
  Inc., of Stanton, CA, for providing as-needed tree trimming and removal services,
  to extend the term of the contract to March 31, 2026. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Parks, Recreation and Marine

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

15. 25-54509  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute an
  agreement, and all necessary documents including any subsequent amendments,
  with the United States Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Assistance, to
  accept and expend grant funding for the Body-Worn Camera Policy and
  Implementation Program to Support Law Enforcement Agencies, in the amount of
  $246,000 for the period of October 1, 2024, to September 30, 2027; and, increase
  appropriations in the General Grants Fund Group in the Police Department by
  $246,000, offset by grant revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CEREMONIALS AND PRESENTATIONS

  GREATER LA COUNTY VECTOR CONTROL DISTRICT SERVICES

  HONORING THE LIFE AND LEGACY OF DR. GERALDINE STRAMSKI

Opportunity to address the City Council (on non-agenda items) is given to the first 10 persons who
submit Speaker Cards to the City Clerk beginning at 15 minutes prior to the commencement of the
meeting. Each speaker is allowed three minutes to make their comments.

REGULAR AGENDA

16. 25-54517  Recommendation to adopt resolution authorizing City Manager, or designee, to
  execute an agreement, and any necessary documents including any subsequent
  amendments, with the California Governor's Office of Business and Economic
  Development (GO-Biz), to receive and expend grant funding in the amount of
  $1,198,263, to support the Cannabis Equity Program, from April 1, 2025, to
  October 31, 2026; and

  Increase appropriations in the General Grants Fund Group in the Economic
  Development Department by $1,198,263, offset by grant revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Economic Development

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

17. 25-54510  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all necessary
  documents and any subsequent amendments, including amendments to the award
  amount or terms, with Health Net of California, Inc. (Health Net) to enter into a fee-
  for-service agreement in an amount up to $3,107,812 for the CalAIM Community
  Supports Program, for an operational period up to one year, effective upon full
  execution of the applicable agreement(s), estimated to begin April 1, 2025, with the
  option to renew for an additional one-year period, at the discretion of the City
  Manager; and

  Increase appropriations in the Health Fund Group in the Health and Human
  Services Department by $3,107,812, offset by grant revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  experiencing homelessness, in a total contract amount not to exceed $796,170,
  made pursuant to Chapters 2.69 and 2.85 of the Long Beach Municipal Code
  (LBMC) and in response to the proclaimed Homelessness and Tuberculosis (TB)
  emergencies; and

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  amend Munis Contract No. 32301386 with Pro Park, LLC, of Hartford, CT, for
  providing shuttle transportation services for people experiencing homelessness, to
  increase the contract amount by $55,000, for a revised contract amount not to
  exceed $851,170, and extend the term of the contract to September 30, 2025.
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

19. 25-54516  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all necessary
  documents and any subsequent amendments, including amending the award
  amount, with the California Department of Housing and Community Development
  (HCD) to accept and expend grant funding in the amount of $11,051,738 for the
  Encampment Resolution Funding Program, for the estimated period of March 2025
  – April 2029, at the discretion of the City Manager; and

  Increase appropriations in the Health Fund Group in the Health and Human
  Services Department by $11,051,738, offset by grant revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

20. 25-54512  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to amend Contract No. 34496 with USA Waste of California,
  Inc. dba Waste Management, of Long Beach, CA, for providing recyclable
  collection services, to increase the annual contract amount by $6,877,982,
  authorize a 20 percent contingency on the full contract in the amount of
  $2,075,596, for a revised total annual contract amount not to exceed $12,453,578,
  and update the contract terms to be in alignment with current practices, state
  requirements, and operational adjustments beginning with the fiscal year ending
  September 30, 2025; and

  Increase appropriations in the Refuse/Recycling Fund Group in the Public Works
  Department by $8,953,578, offset by revenue generated by the proposed rate
  adjustments for May 1, 2025, and August 1, 2025. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Beach (City) amending the Long Beach Municipal Code (LBMC) by amending and

  municipal elections, read the first time and laid over to the next regular meeting of
  the City Council for final reading. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Attorney

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
